correctness.rationale: The exact facets reconstruct the face vector and the six antipodal missing edges. Exact mod-two reduction verifies every nonfacial triangle is nonzero. More strongly, the displayed integral cocycle vanishes on every facial triangle and evaluates exactly +1 on all forty increasing nonfacial triangles. Published H1=Z then identifies every one as the same primitive generator. Exhausting all 2^6*6! pair-preserving permutations proves the full automorphism order and carrier orbits.

value.rationale: This is the complete shortest integral loop layer of a canonical centrally symmetric low-vertex S3 x S1 triangulation. The common +1 cocycle evaluation shows coherent integral orientation of all minimizers, a structural fact not implied by the known rank-one homology or dihedral construction, while the 4,12,24 orbit profile records how the full symmetry organizes that layer.
